+# Architecture
+
+- `src/domain`: orders, customers, invoices and money. Plain functions and types.
+- `src/app`: use cases. They talk to storage and mail through the ports in `src/app/ports.ts`.
+- `src/infra`: Postgres (`pg`) repositories, the SMTP mailer and the HTTP routes. `src/infra/index.ts` wires them.
+- `src/config`: reads the environment once, in `loadSettings()`.
+
+A use case never builds a `PgOrderRepository` or calls `createPool` itself; `src/main.ts` does.
